department: Department of Earth Sciences (PhD in Geological Sciences)

deadline.value: Apply by December 1 for full departmental funding consideration, Presidential/Schomburg fellowships and TAs; later applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
deadline.quote: December 1: for the following fall semester | application submission by December 1 is required.

fee_waiver.value: Fee waivers can be requested only by US citizens and permanent residents.
fee_waiver.quote: U.S. citizens or current permanent residents may request a fee waiver through the application portal

supervisor.value: You must list faculty you would like as mentor and are expected to contact them during the application; the advisor is chosen after enrollment.
supervisor.quote: It is expected that you reach out to faculty during the application process.

funding.value: Funding is considered at application and awarded if funds are available.
funding.quote: Applications received at any time are considered for financial support if funds are available.

entry_route.value: Bachelor's holders typically finish in four years and master's holders in three.
entry_route.quote: For BS Holders: Typically completed in four years. | For MS Holders: Typically completed in three years.
